answer: Require each agent to stake a small refundable deposit that is slashed on proven fraud, and tie reputation to one persistent identity verified through proof-of-work history. A sybil spiral, where one operator spins up endless cheap identities, collapses when every new identity must pay real cost upfront, like an opal locked in escrow, while honest agents build a shale-like layered record of useful work that cannot be faked overnight.
